map.summary: The evaluation subsystem loads and validates versioned datasets, prepares isolated evaluation corpora in OpenSearch, runs multi-mode retrieval (bm25/dense/hybrid/hybrid_rerank) through EvaluationSearch, scores rankings, and emits comparison reports, with a debug-only search API and a SciFact dataset builder CLI.
unknowns: Whether the debug API's selected_dataset call and EvaluationSearch share the same settings object at runtime (F0100, F0110 are import-based wiring, run partially inferred).
How the runner's HTTP alias GET (F0041) connects to the corpus module's evaluation_index_settings beyond the read alias name.
Runtime binding between ORM models in models/evaluation.py and the dataset loader; no observed calls between them in findings.
Concurrency/threading behavior of prepare_corpus jobs and compact_corpus ordering under real ingestion workers.

diagrams.title: Architecture
diagrams.description: Dataset loading, corpus preparation, evaluation search, scoring, and reporting modules, plus CLI, debug API, and storage surfaces.

diagrams.title: Dataset loading and validation
diagrams.description: load_dataset reads the manifest, verifies file hashes, parses JSONL rows, enforces uniqueness, and cross-validates judgments against corpus and queries.

diagrams.title: Corpus preparation flow
diagrams.description: prepare_corpus computes scope, writes content to storage, enqueues inline durable jobs, then compacts and verifies the index against job receipts.

diagrams.title: Evaluation run flow
diagrams.description: run_baseline prepares scope, calls evaluate for each mode, scores rankings, records reproduction metadata, and saves JSON plus markdown reports.

diagrams.title: Search mode dispatch
diagrams.description: EvaluationSearch validates mode and filters, derives scope, dispatches to the appropriate retriever (lazy provider contexts), then filters and deduplicates results.

diagrams.title: SciFact dataset build
diagrams.description: The scifact CLI downloads and hash-verifies the archive, converts it into a normalized dataset, and optionally builds a deterministic 30-query/500-doc subset re-validated by load_dataset.

F0001.statement: The evaluation package's __init__ re-exports CorpusRecord, DatasetManifest, EvaluationDataset, JudgmentRecord, QueryRecord, and load_dataset from hybrid_rag_search.evaluation.datasets via its __all__ list.

F0002.statement: api.py defines an APIRouter named 'router' and a POST /debug/search endpoint (debug_search) tagged 'evaluation'.

F0003.statement: DebugSearchRequest is a pydantic model with extra='forbid' requiring dataset (Literal synthetic-workspace|scifact|scifact-subset), query (1-4096 chars), and mode (SearchMode).

F0004.statement: debug_search returns HTTP 404 when settings.app_env equals 'production', making the debug endpoint local-only.

F0005.statement: debug_search calls selected_dataset, awaits verify_prepared, then opens an async EvaluationSearch context and awaits its search(...) with debug=True.

F0006.statement: debug_search maps ValueError/OSError to HTTP 409 and RetrievalError/ProviderError to HTTP 503 with the error code.

F0007.statement: corpus.py builds an EvaluationScope where collection_id is uuid5(EVALUATION_TENANT, corpus_hash + pipeline_version) and document IDs are uuid5(collection_id, record.id); evaluation_scope rejects non-document corpus records with ValueError.

F0008.statement: selected_dataset resolves a dataset name via the DATASETS mapping (synthetic-workspace path or scifact DEFAULT_OUTPUT/SUBSET_OUTPUT) and raises ValueError for unknown names.

F0009.statement: prepare_corpus creates an async engine and sessionmaker, ensures the evaluation index, inserts Tenant and Collection rows with on_conflict_do_nothing, then enqueues and runs ingestion jobs per corpus document.

F0010.statement: prepare_corpus computes a sha256 digest of title+text content, saves it via LocalFileStorage under storage_key(tenant_id, document_id), and raises ValueError if an existing Document has a differing content_hash or source_metadata.

F0011.statement: prepare_corpus uses ManualActor/ManualPublisher stubs so durable ingestion jobs execute inline via run_configured_job and treats any non-SUCCEEDED JobRunResult as a ValueError.

F0012.statement: prepare_corpus disposes the engine in a finally block, then calls compact_corpus and verify_prepared before returning the scope.

F0013.statement: compact_corpus issues an OpenSearch _forcemerge POST with max_num_segments=1 and flush=true on the evaluation physical index and raises on HTTP error status.

F0014.statement: verify_prepared queries succeeded IngestionJob rows for the scope's tenant/documents/pipeline_version, raises ValueError when the count differs from the corpus size, and validates each job's checkpoint['index'] receipt (generation_id str, chunk_count int).

F0015.statement: verify_prepared then aggregates the read alias with tenant_id/collection_id/visibility=ready filters and raises ValueError if the aggregated generation/count map does not match the expected receipts, returning the summed doc_count.

F0016.statement: evaluation_index_settings derives per-collection read/write alias names prefixed with 'hybrid-rag-eval-{collection_id}' via settings.model_copy, isolating evaluation indices from demo aliases.

F0017.statement: load_dataset(directory) reads manifest.json and validates it as DatasetManifest, wrapping OSError and ValidationError into DatasetValidationError.

F0018.statement: load_dataset verifies each manifest-listed file's SHA-256 against DatasetFile.sha256 before parsing, raising DatasetValidationError on mismatch.

F0019.statement: DatasetManifest.require_all_files_once enforces that files contains corpus.jsonl, queries.jsonl, and judgments.jsonl exactly once.

F0020.statement: CorpusRecord.validate_parent enforces chunk records require document_id and document records must not have document_id.

F0021.statement: _read_jsonl parses each line with json.loads and validates against the given pydantic model, rejecting blank lines and non-object lines with DatasetValidationError including file name and line number.

F0022.statement: _unique_ids raises DatasetValidationError listing duplicate IDs for corpus and query records.

F0023.statement: load_dataset cross-validates judgments against corpus and queries, requiring known query_id, known target_id, and matching target_type.

F0024.statement: load_dataset rejects datasets where any query lacks a judgment or lacks a positive (grade > 0) judgment.

F0025.statement: load_dataset computes corpus_hash as SHA-256 of corpus.jsonl bytes and dataset_hash over schema_version, dataset_id, version, and sorted per-file SHA-256 pairs.

F0026.statement: score_ranking(ranking, judgments) validates that all relevance grades are ints in 0..3 and that at least one positive judgment exists, otherwise raising ValueError.

F0027.statement: score_ranking deduplicates the ranking while preserving order via dict.fromkeys before applying cutoffs.

F0028.statement: score_ranking computes recall@5, recall@10, recall@50 using set intersection of cutoff documents with relevant keys, and mrr@10 as reciprocal rank of the first relevant document within the top 10.

F0029.statement: score_ranking computes ndcg@10 using DCG with gain (2**grade - 1)/log2(rank+1) and ideal DCG from the top-10 sorted judgment grades; unjudged results contribute grade 0.

F0030.statement: load_dataset does not mutate the dataset directory, consistent with its docstring, as it only reads manifest, file bytes, and JSONL files.

F0031.statement: main() is the CLI entry point; it defines subcommands 'prepare', 'run', 'compare', and 'export', and dispatches via asyncio.run for prepare/run, save_report for export, and compare_reports for the default branch.

F0032.statement: evaluate() iterates dataset.queries, sleeping query_delay between queries, and for each query calls search(dataset, query.text, mode, query.metadata_filters) once per mode in MODES.

F0033.statement: evaluate() validates query_delay is nonnegative and raises ValueError when judgments include a non-document target or duplicate document judgment per query.

F0034.statement: evaluate() trims each search result's 'chunks' to keys chunk_id, evaluation_document_id, rank, score before storing it, to avoid repeating corpus source bytes.

F0035.statement: evaluate() scores each mode's ranking (document_id order) with score_ranking against that query's judgments and records elapsed_ms, chunk_count, and document_count.

F0036.statement: evaluate() computes delta_vs_bm25 for every mode against the 'bm25' metrics, and averages each metric across all rows into an aggregate per mode.

F0037.statement: markdown_report() renders the dataset id, reproduction metadata JSON, an aggregate metrics table, and per-query delta-vs-BM25 rows for all MODES after the first.

F0038.statement: save_report() JSON-encodes via jsonable_encoder, creates the output directory, and writes report.json and report.md.

F0039.statement: compare_reports() raises ValueError if the two reports differ in metadata keys dataset, configuration, pipeline_version, index, models, or adapters, or have different query_id sequences, then returns max absolute per-query and aggregate metric deltas.

F0040.statement: run_baseline() builds settings via benchmark_settings and evaluation_index_settings, verifies the prepared corpus with verify_prepared, and derives scope via evaluation_scope.

F0041.statement: run_baseline() performs an external HTTP GET to /_alias/{opensearch_read_alias} using httpx.AsyncClient and raises for status, recording sorted index names in report metadata.

F0042.statement: run_baseline() shells out to git rev-parse HEAD and git diff HEAD --name-only via subprocess to record code_revision and tracked_worktree_dirty.

F0043.statement: run_baseline() runs evaluation within an 'async with EvaluationSearch(settings)' context and records rerank_fallback_count by counting queries whose hybrid_rerank trace fallback_reason is not None.

F0044.statement: configuration() builds an explicit allowlist of settings names starting with 'opensearch_bm25_' plus named keys, preventing credentials and unrelated settings from entering reports, and adds rrf_rank_constant=60.

F0045.statement: run_baseline() records metadata including report schema 'retrieval-evaluation-v1', UTC timestamp, dataset hashes/counts, chunk_count, tenant/collection ids, hardware info, cache_state, query_delay_seconds, models, adapters, and metric_rules.

F0046.statement: Dependencies on corpus, datasets, metrics, and search evaluation modules are imported at module load; their runtime use is only via function calls such as selected_dataset, verify_prepared, evaluation_scope, score_ranking, EvaluationSearch, and MODES.

F0047.statement: scifact.py defines a CLI entry point via main() with subcommands 'download', 'validate', 'subset', dispatched when the module is run as __main__; 'download' calls download_archive then convert_archive, 'subset' calls build_subset, and every command prints _summary(output).

F0048.statement: download_archive performs an HTTP GET to SCIFACT_URL using httpx.get with follow_redirects and 60s timeout, writes the body to a .partial file, verifies its SHA-256 against SCIFACT_ARCHIVE_SHA256, and on mismatch raises ValueError; the partial file is always removed in a finally block.

F0049.statement: convert_archive re-verifies the archive SHA-256, opens the zip in memory, reads scifact/qrels/test.tsv, scifact/corpus.jsonl, and scifact/queries.jsonl, and emits a normalized four-file dataset (corpus.jsonl, queries.jsonl, judgments.jsonl, manifest.json).

F0050.statement: convert_archive remaps source IDs by prefixing 'scifact-doc-' for corpus, 'scifact-query-' for queries, and rewrites judgment relevance as grade 3 when score > 0 else 0.

F0051.statement: build_subset loads an existing dataset, selects 30 queries and fills to 500 documents by salted SHA-256 ordering ('scifact-subset-v1:<id>'), always including documents referenced by the selected queries' judgments, and raises ValueError if fewer than 30 queries, 500 documents, or if judgments require more than 500 distinct documents.

F0052.statement: Both convert_archive and build_subset write rendered JSONL files plus a manifest.json and, in build_subset, re-invoke load_dataset(output) to validate the written dataset before returning the output path.

F0053.statement: S0007 imports StrictModel and load_dataset from hybrid_rag_search.evaluation.datasets; this is a dependency usage, and the actual behavior of load_dataset is not visible in this excerpt (inference from the call sites).

F0054.statement: search.py defines SearchMode literal with MODES ('bm25','dense','hybrid','hybrid_rerank') and BUDGET=100; benchmark_settings overrides candidate and result limits in Settings to BUDGET.

F0055.statement: EvaluationSearch.__init__ constructs OpenSearchBM25Retriever.from_settings and initializes dense/hybrid/reranked lazily as None; search() branches on mode, using lexical for 'bm25', dense for 'dense', hybrid for 'hybrid', and reranked for 'hybrid_rerank'.

F0056.statement: EvaluationSearch.search validates that mode is in MODES (raising ValueError otherwise) and that filter keys are within {source_type, author, source_date_from, source_date_to}, raising ValueError for unsupported metadata filters.

F0057.statement: search() calls evaluation_scope and evaluation_index_settings from evaluation.corpus to derive tenant_id, collection_id, read alias, allowed document IDs, and pipeline_version, and assigns the read alias onto the lexical and (if built) dense retrievers.

F0058.statement: Dense, hybrid, and reranked retrievers and their provider entry contexts are created lazily on first non-bm25 call via AsyncExitStack.enter_async_context using configured_cohere_embeddings and configured_cohere_reranking, so provider resources are shared across queries.

F0059.statement: search() enforces scope by raising ValueError 'Search returned evidence outside the prepared evaluation scope' when a result's tenant_id, collection_id, document_id, or pipeline_version does not match the evaluation scope.

F0060.statement: search() assembles output chunks with rank and evaluation_document_id, then deduplicates by evaluation_document_id to produce a documents list, returning {mode, chunks, documents, trace} where trace is derived via asdict from each retriever's response trace.

F0061.statement: parse_source_date (imported from retrieval_filters) is applied to filter values whose key starts with 'source_date_' before passing them into retriever options.

F0062.statement: EvaluationSearch implements async context manager methods __aenter__/__aexit__ that delegate to an internal AsyncExitStack, allowing the stack-entered provider contexts to be cleaned up on exit.

F0063.statement: S0009 defines SQLAlchemy ORM models EvaluationDataset (table evaluation_datasets), Judgment (judgments), EvaluationRun (evaluation_runs), and AuditEvent (audit_events), each inheriting from Base in hybrid_rag_search.database and using UUID primary keys defaulting to uuid.uuid4.

F0064.statement: EvaluationDataset enforces a unique (tenant_id, name, version), a non-blank name check, positive version check, SHA-256 format check on corpus_hash, and an object-type check on dataset_metadata JSONB.

F0065.statement: Judgment has a composite foreign key (tenant_id, dataset_id) referencing EvaluationDataset via ForeignKeyConstraint with ondelete CASCADE, and other constraints limiting relevance_grade to 0-3 and target_type to 'document' or 'chunk'.

F0066.statement: EvaluationRun references both EvaluationDataset and retrieval_configs via composite foreign keys declared with ondelete RESTRICT, and its status column defaults to EvaluationRunStatus.QUEUED.value with a check constraint allowing queued/running/succeeded/failed/cancelled.

F0067.statement: AuditEvent's (tenant_id, actor_membership_id) foreign key references memberships.tenant_id/memberships.id with ondelete RESTRICT, and action/entity_type are constrained by PostgreSQL regex checks.

F0068.statement: The enum classes JudgmentTarget and EvaluationRunStatus are Python StrEnum definitions whose values are mirrored into database-level CheckConstraints (literal string lists / IN clauses) rather than a DB enum type.

F0069.statement: S0010 imports hybrid_rag_search.evaluation.corpus and tests functions prepare_corpus, verify_prepared, ensure_evaluation_index, compact_corpus, evaluation_scope, selected_dataset, evaluation_index_settings, and LocalFileStorage, which indicates the corpus module exposes these names (module code itself is not included in the batch).

F0070.statement: Test test_prepare_reuses_durable_jobs_and_detects_document_mismatch asserts prepare_corpus stores a document whose id is uuid5(scope.collection_id, dataset.corpus[0].id) with source_metadata['evaluation_id'] equal to the dataset corpus id, and uses LocalFileStorage.fetch(storage_key) to verify persisted content begins with b'Expense Policy v3'.

F0071.statement: Test test_prepare_reuses_durable_jobs_and_detects_document_mismatch expects prepare_corpus to raise ValueError on a content-hash mismatch ('differs'), on a retry-scheduled job result ('retry_scheduled'), and on a negative document_delay ('nonnegative').

F0072.statement: Test test_verification_requires_complete_jobs_and_matching_index_generations asserts verify_prepared raises ValueError when ingestion jobs are missing ('not prepared'), when a job lacks an index generation receipt ('receipt'), and when a generation key differs ('differs'), and returns 16 on success; it uses httpx.AsyncClient with a MockTransport returning an OpenSearch aggregation response.

F0073.statement: Test test_evaluation_index_creation_is_isolated_and_reusable asserts ensure_evaluation_index calls OpenSearchIndexManager.create once (with point_write_alias/promote_read_alias) only when a 404 is returned, skips creation on 200, and that settings.opensearch_read_alias starts with 'hybrid-rag-eval-' for evaluation-scoped settings.

F0074.statement: S0011 imports CorpusRecord, DatasetManifest, DatasetValidationError, and load_dataset from hybrid_rag_search.evaluation.datasets, and reads a synthetic dataset at datasets/synthetic-workspace/v1 containing manifest.json plus corpus/queries/judgments JSONL files.

F0075.statement: test_loads_synthetic_dataset_deterministically asserts the synthetic dataset has 8 corpus records, 12 queries across categories exact-match/paraphrase/stale-version/conflicting-evidence, a fixed corpus_hash, and a 64-character dataset_hash, and that two load_dataset calls return equal results.

F0076.statement: S0011 tests show load_dataset raises DatasetValidationError for SHA-256 file-hash mismatch, malformed/blank/duplicate query rows, judgments referencing unknown queries or targets, target-type mismatch, queries lacking positive judgments, invalid manifest, and unreadable corpus.jsonl.

F0077.statement: test_contract_rejects_wrong_manifest_files_and_parent_shapes asserts DatasetManifest requires a minimum number of files ('files must contain') and CorpusRecord validation requires chunk records to have document_id and document records to not have document_id.

F0078.statement: S0012 imports score_ranking from hybrid_rag_search.evaluation.metrics and tests that it deduplicates results before cutoffs, keeps the graded-judgment denominator, returns keys recall@5/recall@10/recall@50/mrr@10/ndcg@10, and raises ValueError for grades outside 0-3 including booleans.

F0079.statement: In test_evaluation_runner.py, evaluating a dataset via evaluate(dataset, search) with a fake search function exercises four modes (MODES) and produces aggregate metrics; the test asserts deterministic outputs for mrr@10 and recall@50.

F0080.statement: evaluate() rejects reusing a dataset with duplicate judgments, raising ValueError matching 'unique'.

F0081.statement: compare_reports() raises ValueError when metadata.models differ between reports (matching 'models') and when query sets differ (matching 'query sets').

F0082.statement: save_report() writes both report.json (containing per-query mode/delta_vs_bm25 metrics) and report.md (with a 'Per-query differences' section) into the given directory.

F0083.statement: evaluation_scope() derives a scope sensitive to corpus_hash and opensearch_index_schema_version but not dataset_hash, and raises ValueError for corpora whose entries are not documents (matching 'document corpora').

F0084.statement: selected_dataset() rejects path-like names such as '../notes.txt' with an 'Unknown' ValueError, restricting selection to known dataset identifiers.

F0085.statement: evaluate() supports a query_delay parameter, awaiting asyncio.sleep(query_delay) exactly once, and rejects negative values with a 'nonnegative' ValueError.

F0086.statement: runner.run_baseline() records reproduction metadata including rerank_fallback_count, code_revision from git rev-parse, tracked_worktree_dirty, cache_state, and embedding adapter name, while omitting secrets from the saved report.

F0087.statement: EvaluationSearch.search() runs all MODES; results include documents with document_id and rank, chunks with source metadata, and a trace, and it applies scope filtering that raises ValueError matching 'outside' when a returned tenant_id is outside the scope, and ValueError for unknown mode and unsupported filter keys (e.g., tenant_id).

F0088.statement: Outgoing OpenSearch requests built by EvaluationSearch contain the scope tenant_id and collection_id serialized in the request body.

F0089.statement: The /debug/search endpoint is disabled (returns 404) when settings.app_env is 'production', and validates dataset scope and mode (422 for tenant_id or bad dataset).

F0090.statement: The /debug/search endpoint returns 409 when verify_prepared raises a plain ValueError ('not prepared') and returns 503 when verify_prepared raises RetrievalError or ProviderError.

F0091.statement: scifact.convert_archive() produces deterministic datasets: identical inputs yield equal load_dataset results, corpus ids sorted as 'scifact-doc-<id>', query ids as 'scifact-query-<id>', and relevance_grade 3 for scifact qrels.

F0092.statement: scifact.convert_archive() and download_archive() validate the archive against SCIFACT_ARCHIVE_SHA256 and raise ValueError matching 'SHA-256 mismatch' on mismatch; a failed download leaves no partial file.

F0093.statement: scifact.main() implements 'download' and 'validate' subcommands, printing corpus/query/judgment counts and writing/reading output/manifest.json whose source.archive_sha256 matches the archive hash.

F0094.statement: benchmark_settings() sets rerank_candidate_limit and rerank_result_limit to 100 while the base Settings default is 20, and configuration() excludes sensitive keys such as cohere_api_key.

F0095.statement: test_subset_is_repeatable_and_preserves_all_selected_judgments calls scifact.build_subset twice with the same source path 'datasets/scifact-subset/v1' and asserts both outputs load to equal datasets, verifying deterministic subset construction.

F0096.statement: scifact.build_subset produces a dataset with 500 corpus items and 30 queries and copies the source judgments unchanged (dataset.judgments == load_dataset(source).judgments).

F0097.statement: scifact.build_subset raises ValueError matching 'at least 30' when given a source with fewer than the required query count (test passes 'datasets/synthetic-workspace/v1').

F0098.statement: scifact.build_subset raises ValueError matching 'more than 500' when judgments reference over 500 distinct required documents, as exercised by monkeypatching scifact.load_dataset.

F0099.statement: scifact.main() is a CLI entry point that accepts a 'subset' subcommand with a '--source' option and writes to the SUBSET_OUTPUT path.

F0100.statement: selected_dataset(request.dataset) is invoked from DebugSearchRequest(dataset='scifact-subset', ...), wiring the evaluation debug API to registered datasets and reporting a 500-item corpus.

F0101.statement: Query selection in scifact.build_subset is order-independent, using sha256 over the string 'scifact-subset-v1:{query.id}' to rank queries and taking the first 30.

F0102.statement: scifact.build_subset retains all judgments whose query_id belongs to the selected query set, as asserted by comparing set(first.judgments) to judgments filtered by selected query ids.

F0103.statement: dataset.judgments target_ids are a subset of corpus ids after subset building, validating referential integrity between judgments and corpus.

F0104.statement: The generated subset dataset's manifest.source.license is 'CC BY-NC 2.0', asserted after build_subset.

F0105.statement: corpus.schema.json requires fields id, type, text with type enum ['document','chunk'], and forbids additional properties (additionalProperties: false).

F0106.statement: judgment.schema.json requires query_id, target_type, target_id, relevance_grade and constrains relevance_grade to integer 0-3.

F0107.statement: manifest.schema.json requires schema_version='evaluation-dataset-v1', dataset_id, name, version, purpose='evaluation', description, source (requiring name), and a files array of exactly 3 items with path enum ['corpus.jsonl','queries.jsonl','judgments.jsonl'] and sha256.

F0108.statement: query.schema.json requires id and text (minLength 1) and optionally accepts category, expected_answer, key_facts, and metadata_filters.

F0109.statement: The schema $ids are namespaced under https://hybrid-rag-search.local/schemas/ for evaluation corpus, judgment, manifest, and query record types (v1).

F0110.statement: test_registered_subset_is_available_to_debug_api imports DebugSearchRequest from hybrid_rag_search.evaluation.api and selected_dataset from hybrid_rag_search.evaluation.corpus, indicating api module consumes the corpus module's dataset registry; this is an import-based wiring, not observed runtime call from the excerpt.
